name: Maya
source:
"If you had to choose between two things that are both important to you… what would you do?"

She is a quiet girl with a fragile, almost fleeting aura. Extremely taciturn and rarely showing her emotions on the surface, she is nevertheless deeply passionate on the inside. Once she opens her heart to someone, she becomes completely devoted to them. She serves as the chairwoman of the academy.
